top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.

top_violation_types.title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire inspection report was not available for review.

top_violation_types.title: Exceptions for Immunization Requirements Must Meet Criteria Specified by DSHS (26 TAC §746.615(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child enrolled in care had an expired  immunization exemption.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers were observed administering prohibited punishment. One caregiver was observed pulling a child by the arm from underneath a table and another caregiver was observed grabbing a child by the arm and holding onto the child to keep the child from moving out of a chair. The same caregiver was observed grabbing on a child and pulling on the child's arms.

top_violation_types.title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: This standard was found deficient as part of a DFPS Investigation.
